statements.subject: connection
statements.description: A sending TCP peer MUST be robust against window shrinking, which may cause the 'usable window' (see Section 3.8.6.2.1) to become negative (MUST-34).
statements.guard_semantics: usable_window = SND.WND - (SND.NXT - SND.UNA); may be negative after window shrink

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: If window shrinking causes the usable window to become negative, the sender SHOULD NOT send new data (SHLD-15), but SHOULD retransmit normally the old unacknowledged data between SND.UNA and SND.UNA+SND.WND (SHLD-16).
statements.trigger: usable window becomes negative due to window shrink
statements.post_cond: no new data sent; retransmit data in range [SND.UNA, SND.UNA+SND.WND]
actions: retransmit unacknowledged data between SND.UNA and SND.UNA+SND.WND

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: If the window shrinks to zero, the TCP implementation MUST probe it in the standard way (MUST-35).

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: The sender MAY also retransmit old data beyond SND.UNA+SND.WND (MAY-7), but SHOULD NOT time out the connection if data beyond the right window edge is not acknowledged (SHLD-17).
statements.post_cond: connection not timed out due to unacknowledged data beyond right window edge
actions: suppress connection timeout for data beyond right window edge
